bibl.note: P. Cair. Inv. 10298 a [ed.: Belal Abou El Ala, Ten Greek Papyri from Cairo Museum, BACPS 23 (2006 [2008]) pp. 23-119, No. 8] + b. Letter from Pyrrandrus and others to Heracleides about the produce of a vineyard. Probably from Gurob, June 4, 243 BCE.
